independenceStatement: This reviewer did not generate or import these images and did not consult the generating agent's acceptance decisions. Decisions are based on the actual candidate rasters and the current canonical goal texts.
title: Spiegelungen von Funktionsgraphen beschreiben
description: Die lernende Person kann Spiegelungen an der x-Achse, y-Achse oder am Ursprung anhand von Vorzeichenänderungen im Funktionsterm beschreiben und grafisch darstellen.
checks: Viewed all four actual raster panels.
Starting with f(x)=(x−1)²+1 and P(1,1), the three panels correctly use −f(x)=−(x−1)²−1 with P′(1,−1), f(−x)=(x+1)²+1 with P′(−1,1), and −f(−x)=−(x+1)²−1 with P′(−1,−1).
Opening direction and side of each axis match the correct transformation. Coordinate transformation rules are correct.
The unticked mini-graphs are schematic. Small differences in drawing scale between separate panels are not a substantive defect.
scope: Targeted independent candidate-image review only. No active-asset import and no full goal-completion or human-approval claim.
